The '''Kanzer Exiles''' were an ancient and fanatical flock of [[Unidentified reptoid species|reptilians]] led by the [[Lord Ravager]] [[Korman Lao]]. These exiles spread their faith through mental enslavement and constructed a [[Planet/Legends|world]]-sized [[Temple of Korman Lao|temple]] near the [[Valtaullu Rift/Legends|Valtaullu Rift]]. In time, the philosophy of the Kanzer Exiles and [[Knell of Muspilli|other]] [[Warriors of Shadow|groups]] from the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] became part of the ideological foundation of the later organization known as the [[Sorcerers of Rhand]].

==History==
{{Quote|Thank you, Mother Talsin, for the reminder. Recruit them or kill them? My newest Shadow Hund must mount an expedition to this corner of the Unknown Regions.|Personal records of [[Palpatine|Darth Sidious]] about the Kanzer Exiles|<ref name="BS" />}}
[[File:UnknownRegions-TEA.png|left|thumb|280px|The Kanzer Exiles originated from the distant corners of the Unknown Regions]]
At the dawn of history, in the [[Valtaullu Rift/Legends|Valtaullu Rift]],<ref name="BS" /> from the depths of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]],<ref name="SM" /> there existed a fanatical flock of [[Unidentified reptoid species|reptilians]] known as the Kanzer Exiles.<ref name="UR" /> They worshiped [[Demon/Legends|demons]]<ref name="SM" /> and forcibly spread their faith through the mental enslavement of many [[Sentience/Legends|minds]] at once. They were led by a [[Lord Ravager]] named [[Korman Lao]], to whom the followers of the order swore loyalty,<ref name="BS" /> and in honor of their leader they even built a colossal [[Temple of Korman Lao|temple]] the size of a [[Planet/Legends|world]].<ref name="UR" />

Many [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] later, mention of the Kanzer Exiles appeared in the ''[[Book of Sith]]'' within the section «[[Wild Power]]», authored by the [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomirian]] [[Witches of Dathomir|witch]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]], who regarded the true capabilities of the organization with skepticism. [[Palpatine|Darth Sidious]] studied the available information and faced a choice: whether to recruit the reptilians of Valtaullu for his own purposes or simply destroy them. In any case, Sidious was pleased that Talzin’s records had reminded him of the sectarians, and he began to consider sending his newest [[Shadow Hand]] on an expedition into the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="BS" />

By the time of the formation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] adept [[Cronal]] had discovered the ruins of Lao’s temple after studying scraps of the [[Taurannik Codex]]. Along his path, Cronal encountered no followers of the Kanzer Exiles, which was likely explained by the group’s disappearance by that time, as the reptilians of Valtaullu were already considered long-vanished.<ref name="SM" /> However, the sect’s existence had not passed without trace, for over many generations their philosophical schools – together with the death cult of the [[Knell of Muspilli]] and the [[Taung/Legends|Taung]] [[Warriors of Shadow|priestly]] community – gave rise to the religious movement known as the [[Sorcerers of Rhand]] beneath the shroud of the [[Perann Nebula/Legends|Perann Nebula]] within the same [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="UR" />

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[The Unknown Regions]]'' sourcebook, the name «Kanzer Exiles» was written with capital letters, but later, when referring to the group, the word «exiles» was written in lowercase. This orthographic detail suggested that the group’s followers might indeed have been exiled from somewhere.
